title: CLI Commands
description: Schema for the generated cli_commands.json produced by 'specdev registry-generate': the command paths the toolkit CLI offers. Not canon. Carries paths only, no flags.

$schema.description: Schema URI identifying this document as a CLI command list. Must be 'vc:cli-commands'.

_format_version.description: Semver string for the file format.

_note.description: Human-readable note about the file's origin. Consumers should not parse this string.

commands.description: Every command path, sorted: a top-level command ('spec-check') or a command followed by a sub-command or action ('json patch', 'align apply').

path.description: Space-separated command path as typed after 'specdev'.
